The Florida Elite Feature Set

Four pillars that make GigitekAI the only MSP built specifically for Florida's unique risk environment.

Disaster-Proof Agentic Cloud

We don't just back up your data — we replicate your entire business logic into a sovereign AI vault. If your physical office goes dark, your AI Agents keep processing orders, triaging tickets, and serving clients.

FIPA Compliance Automation

Florida's Information Protection Act requires breach notification within 30 days. Our agents monitor data flows automatically and trigger notifications before deadlines — no manual tracking required.

< 15 Minute RTO

Standard Florida MSPs promise 4–24 hour recovery. We deliver instant failover with sub-15-minute Recovery Time Objectives, keeping your business operational through any disaster.

Florida Sovereign Cloud

Data residency in Tier 4 data centers across Miami (primary), Tampa (secondary), and Atlanta (out-of-region DR). Low latency with geographic redundancy built for Florida's unique risk profile.
